calls.statement:
SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  fiscal_period,
  fiscal_period_label,
  period_start_date,
  period_end_date,
  fully_loaded
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT 
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  p.category,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = false
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name, p.category
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- Check for any data quality issues in the period
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_lines,
  COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) as distinct_receipts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.product_key) as distinct_products,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 END) as non_member_sales,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag = true THEN 1 END) as staff_purchases
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5;
